headline: KUN (PROP) surges 29.63% on a massive 8.8σ volume spike, becoming today’s biggest mover.
market_take: The market showed mixed activity across sectors. Construction stocks were volatile with TRITN plunging 33.33% intraday while PLE rose 11.11%. Food saw strong price moves, notably F&D up 18.75% on zero volume and price gaps in AQUA and XBIO. Property was the most active, driven by KUN’s 29.63% jump, PF’s 25% rise, and several 100% price gaps indicating possible suspensions. Unusual‑trading alerts highlighted volume spikes and intraday moves in multiple sectors, and several high‑impact filings were released, especially for A PROP and XBIO.

sector_notes.note: F&D jumped 18.75% despite no trading volume, while AQUA and XBIO opened with gaps of -9.09% and -12.50% respectively; XBIO also filed a SET clarification.
KUN led with a 29.63% rise on an 8.8σ volume spike, PF added a 25% intraday gain, and A PROP, PRIN and TLHPF each posted a -100% price gap, the former accompanied by a connected‑transaction filing.
TRITN fell 33.33% intraday, while PLE and SOLAR posted intraday gains of 11.11% and 9.52% respectively; BJCHI saw a trading‑sign posting and multiple capital‑change filings.
NER recorded a 4.5σ volume spike and TL moved up 8.11% intraday.
GEL experienced a 4.7σ volume spike, indicating heightened interest.
M-PAT dropped 15.33% intraday, and TLHPF opened with a -100% price gap.
